blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Health (DOH) on Tuesday warned the public against individuals posing as Health Secretary Edwin Mercado and soliciting donations. “The DOH wants to clarify that any messages or calls for donations or transactions using the name of the Secretary are not official and false,” it said in a statement. READ: DOH flags online scams offering false cures for hypertension “The public is reminded to be careful and to refrain from contacting, giving money or transacting with suspicious accounts, numbers or messages,” it added.
